scope: Authorized practical-information and remaining-gap research; no application code changes or outreach.
method: Primary operator, transport and shopping-centre pages; festival-organizer access notes; public PDF technical/legal documents.
Reused same-day public operator HTML and saved Google listing snapshots without requesting account/browser access.
Decoded publicly delivered shopping-centre page content for transport directions; no cart, customer or payment APIs used.
Normalized Maps positive/negative display values rather than assuming an accessibility icon means yes.
Prices deduplicated across venues; membership and subscriber extras never mixed with ordinary admission.
Source/date/condition and explicit unresolved fields retained. Public business entity identifiers retained; individual IDs from PDFs excluded.
excluded_or_unconfirmed_leads: Teatro del Bosque in Móstoles is not Mooby Bosque.
La Farga event-auditorium 213 seats and 3x3 m screen are not the Cinesa multiplex.
Aribau 66 bar screen is not Mooby Aribau.
Balmes architectural 25x25 m concrete screens are structural walls, not cinema projection screens.
Generic chain accessibility apps and 2015/2020 references do not establish current support in each sala.
Secondary IMAX area estimates cannot establish measured width and height.
Old Maquinista 13-screen/2463-seat listings and inconsistent directory prices are not current Premium cinema tariffs.
Bosque large-room captions without a number and temporary Aribau theatre-production photographs do not identify new current sala interiors.
Phenomena legacy cash-only statement, historical bus routes, and indexed template price placeholders are not current visitor instructions.
No outside-food, late-admission, hearing-loop or payment-method policy inferred from customer complaints or missing text.

conflicts.description: Google listing says no accessible seating, but the operator lists wheelchair positions in all 28 rooms. Neither statement is silently discarded; use the room table for published counts and confirm the required route.
Different Kinépolis FAQs give before/after-start refund deadlines; general terms are more restrictive. Scenarios and source statements are kept separate.
Both language versions say 0.05 cents per minute. This may be a unit error; no EUR-per-minute number is inferred.
Fresh same-day operator HTML says EUR 7; an older indexed excerpt says EUR 6.90. The captured HTML is used, dated 2026-11-19.
The EUR 10 English heading names Friday, Saturday and holidays, but not Sunday. The separate EUR 13 Sunday-inclusive heading applies to Gran Sarrià only and is not borrowed.

access_limits: Earlier denied Chrome access and blocked Maps galleries not retried or bypassed.
HTTP 403 responses were not bypassed; previously available text and public indexed excerpts are labelled.
Kinépolis local rules PDF, general-conditions PDF and Movie Club page were inaccessible; detailed terms are not invented.
No messages sent, accounts created, tickets purchased or operator contacts submitted.

checks: All eight cinema IDs, place IDs and practical fact/price joins reconcile.
53 distinct sourced facts, 33 typed price records and 27 positive/negative Maps attribute observations reconcile.
Every source reference resolves across practical data, central dossiers and room catalogue.
All local report links and explicit venue anchors resolve.
La Farga EUR 0.055/min retains its three-decimal precision in JSON and the readable table.
85 rooms, 85 capacity-observation records, 29 measured screens, 56 layouts, 86 image references and four tours remain unchanged.
All 86 cached image files exist; six source-identified interior-room associations remain unchanged.
Aribau access notes join to all five rooms; positions are kept separate from seat capacities.
Yelmo legal PDF relevant pages visually checked; published policy scope and refund conflicts remain explicit.
validation.application_tests: Not run: research data and documentation only; application code unchanged.
